[RARC.10.1] **An engine runs the artefact it was created with for its whole
life.** To change the rule set, the integrator
frees the engine and creates a new one from the new `.dsc`. The new engine's
stream is a new session with the new `ruleset_hash` ([LFST.13.2],
[LFST.13.3]), and the new engine inherits nothing from the old one: what the
integrator wants carried across, it asserts again.
